title: Ignition Lockout (Knight)
shortDescription: Knight or WHB failed to prove flame and locked out.
fullDescription:
F01 on Lochinvar Knight, WHB and Knight Wall-Mount boilers indicates ignition lockout after three failed trials. Causes include closed gas valve, low LP supply, electrode wear, or condensate-flooded burner.

The SMART System control will prompt the operator to press Reset. If the code returns, escalate to a service tech rather than repeatedly resetting.
safetyWarning: Gas appliance — if you smell gas, evacuate and call your gas emergency line.

fixSteps.title: Verify gas
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm gas valve at the boiler is open.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Press Reset on the SMART panel.

fixSteps.title: Inspect electrode
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, remove electrode, clean and gap (typ. 1/8 in).

whenToCallPro: Gas pressure verification — manometer required.

faq.a: Two; if it returns again call a tech.

title: Flame Sensed Out of Sequence
shortDescription: Flame seen when gas valve should be closed.
fullDescription: F02 is logged when ionization is detected outside the valid burn window. Possibilities include a stuck gas valve or a flame-rod insulation breakdown.
safetyWarning: Treat as serious — possible gas-valve fault.

fixSteps.title: Inspect ionization rod
fixSteps.instruction: Look for chafed insulation or damp porcelain.

whenToCallPro: Gas valve replacement is pro-only.

faq.q: Is it safe to keep running?
faq.a: No — fix before relying on heat.

title: Air-Pressure Switch Stuck Closed
shortDescription: APS already closed before the inducer started.
fullDescription: F03 indicates the air-pressure switch is welded or stuck closed. The control sees the switch closed when the inducer is off and refuses to start as a safety.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass the APS.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Check the APS leads for shorts to chassis.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: Swap the APS with the OEM Lochinvar part.

whenToCallPro: If wiring damage is hidden in the harness.

title: Air-Pressure Switch Stuck Open
shortDescription: APS did not close when fan ramped up.
fullDescription: F04 means the inducer is running but the air-proving switch never closed. Either the blower is not actually moving air, the hose is split, or the switch has failed open.
safetyWarning: Vent obstruction risks CO spillage; do not bypass switch.

fixSteps.title: Check terminations
fixSteps.instruction: Clear any obstruction; verify in winter for ice.

fixSteps.title: Inspect hose
fixSteps.instruction: Look for cracks or condensate in the silicone tube.

whenToCallPro: Blower replacement.

faq.q: Where do I get the OEM hose?
faq.a: Lochinvar offers hose kits — buy genuine.

title: High Limit Open
fullDescription: F05 is a high-limit lockout. Like F.02 on Vitodens, it points to a flow problem, scaled HX, or sensor fault.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass the high limit.

fixSteps.title: Verify circulator
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm the system pump is running.

whenToCallPro: Circulator replacement.

faq.a: Air comes out of solution after cooling; bleed and refill.

title: LWCO / Low Pressure
fullDescription: F06 means the LWCO probe or pressure transducer has indicated insufficient water. Refill to 12 psi cold and look for leaks.
safetyWarning: Never bypass the LWCO.
whenToCallPro: If leak is hidden or LWCO replacement is needed.

faq.a: Often a relief valve weeping — check the discharge.

title: Outlet Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Boiler outlet NTC out of range.
fullDescription: F09 means the supply temperature sensor is open or shorted. The boiler will not fire without it.
safetyWarning: Power off before sensor work.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Replace sensor with OEM if open.

whenToCallPro: Sensor well requires draining HX.

faq.a: Use OEM only — temperature curve must match.

title: Inlet Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F10 covers the inlet/return sensor. Boiler relies on it for delta-T computation and HX protection.
safetyWarning: Power off before sensor work.
whenToCallPro: Draining and refilling.

title: Flue Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Flue temperature sensor out of range.
fullDescription: F13 covers the flue NTC. Lochinvar uses this to limit firing rate to keep PVC vents safe.
safetyWarning: Do not bypass — required for flue protection.
whenToCallPro: If gasket reset is required.

title: Blower Speed Fault
shortDescription: Combustion blower RPM does not match command.
fullDescription: F15 occurs when the SMART control sees the fan tach feedback fall outside tolerance from the PWM command. Causes are debris in impeller, bad PWM cable, or aged fan motor.
safetyWarning: Disconnect line voltage before fan work.
whenToCallPro: Blower replacement.

title: Outdoor sensor
fullDescription: Outdoor air temp sensor open/short. Common diagnostic code on Lochinvar boiler. Resolve by following manufacturer service procedure for the implicated subsystem.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power for 10 minutes, then restore.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect the implicated component, wiring, and connectors.

fixSteps.title: Test/replace
fixSteps.instruction: Test sensor with multimeter or replace if reading abnormal.

fixSteps.title: Verify
fixSteps.instruction: Restore power, clear codes, run system to verify.

safetyWarning: Gas/electric appliance — turn off gas and disconnect electrical power before servicing.
whenToCallPro: Gas-appliance work usually requires licensed HVAC tech.

faq.a: Resolve before continued use to prevent damage or safety hazard.

title: Outlet Sensor Short
fullDescription: Lochinvar F26 indicates a short on the outlet (supply) sensor circuit. The boiler cannot trust temperature and locks out.
whenToCallPro: Persistent short after sensor replacement = wiring damage; call a tech.

title: Inlet Sensor Open
fullDescription: Code F27 is an open inlet/return sensor. Reseat or replace.
whenToCallPro: If sensor checks good, call a tech.

title: Inlet Sensor Short
fullDescription: Code F28 indicates a short on the inlet/return sensor.
whenToCallPro: Persistent short means wiring damage; call a tech.

title: Flue Sensor Open
fullDescription: Code F29: open flue thermistor circuit.
whenToCallPro: If sensor checks good, call a tech.

title: Internal Communication Error
fullDescription: Code F45 is an internal communication fault between the display and main control. Reseat ribbon cable; replace display or PCB if it remains.

fixSteps.title: Reseat Ribbon
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat ribbon between display and PCB.

whenToCallPro: If reseating fails, call a Lochinvar technician.

title: Combustion Fan Speed Low
shortDescription: Combustion fan running below commanded speed.
fullDescription: Code F51 indicates that fan tachometer feedback is below the commanded RPM by more than the allowed margin. Bearings or motor windings are typical wear items.
whenToCallPro: Fan replacement requires a heating technician.

title: Combustion Fan Speed High
fullDescription: Code F52 indicates the fan is over-spinning the commanded RPM. Often a tach miscount or PCB output fault.
whenToCallPro: If tach is intact, call a Lochinvar tech to test the PCB.

title: Air Pressure Switch Open at Run
shortDescription: Pressure switch opened during run cycle.
fullDescription: Code F53 indicates the air pressure switch opened during firing — vent restriction, condensate, or switch failure.

fixSteps.title: Drain Tubing
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and clear pressure switch tubing.

whenToCallPro: If venting and switch are good, call a tech.

title: Outdoor Sensor Open
fullDescription: Code F60 indicates open circuit on the outdoor reset sensor. Outdoor reset is disabled until corrected.
whenToCallPro: If sensor and wire are good, call a tech.

title: Outdoor Sensor Short
fullDescription: Code F61 is the short-circuit counterpart to F60.
whenToCallPro: If sensor and wire are good, call a tech.

title: Header Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Code F79 on Lochinvar boilers configured in a cascade indicates the common header sensor is invalid. Cascade modulation defaults to local outlet sensor.

whenToCallPro: Damper service is a pro task.

title: Low Voltage Detected

safetyWarning: Low voltage can damage motors - resolve before reuse.

fixSteps.title: Measure Voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Check line voltage at the boiler under load.

whenToCallPro: Wiring issues require an electrician.
